claims.statement: Exact rejection radius and singleton S<A characterization for initially accepted targets.
claims.verification: --recheck-finite checks 18779 finite-domain cases; proof still requires mathematical assessment.
claims.limitations: Same RHS, protected target row, independent unit cell costs, ties reject; no generic classifier claim.

claims.statement: Canonical accepting actions dominate arbitrary edits without higher cost; at most 2^q+1 actions per row preserve the optimum.
claims.verification: --recheck-finite reconstructs 30642 radii, 30618 witnesses and 61854 row-action comparisons.
claims.limitations: Finite checks do not prove the general theorem. Action count is exponential in q; no universal speed guarantee.

claims.statement: Separate generic raw-cell MILP agrees with raw enumeration on 2118 small cases, including 18 infeasible ones.
claims.verification: Default: recompute all 2118 raw optima and check 2100 witnesses; no solver rerun.

claims.statement: E010 has 72 cases, 288 method observations, 14 generic timeout observations and one slower specialized rejected case; rejected paired median time ratio is 2.996694809745792.
claims.verification: Default: regenerate inputs and recompute timing arithmetic, statuses, exact-pair denominators and slower count.
claims.limitations: Two repetitions on one shared Mac; only exact pairs enter ratios; no new timing measurement or representative speedup claim.

claims.statement: E011 covers 18734 targets, including 13762 accepted; keys yield 1133 fixed-INF transitions and one finite 2-to-1 decrease.
claims.verification: Default checks coverage/arithmetic/coordinate costs. --source-root reconstructs raw decisions, radii and witnesses.
claims.limitations: Reused tables, ordinary-category empties, complete dirty-table contexts; no blind holdout or population prevalence.

claims.statement: Of 32 selected rejected targets, 30 exact full/fixed pairs have no strict gain; two full Rayyan models time out without a primal/bound. Their full optima remain unknown.
claims.verification: Default: verify dirty-only selection, all statuses and exact-pair denominators; source option verifies existing witnesses.
claims.limitations: A fixed optimum of 104 is an upper bound for a timed-out full problem, not proof of its optimum; rejected subset is not representative.

claims.statement: 1493 accepted targets differ from aligned references despite full radius at least two; stability is not reference correctness.
claims.verification: Default checks label/bucket arithmetic; --source-root checks the labels against source references.
claims.limitations: Reference equality is not semantic truth adjudication or calibrated confidence.

claims.statement: Minimum interventions, predicate partitions, generic optimization and voting margins are credited prior ingredients; no worldwide-first claim is made.
claims.verification: Source arguments and inspected primary references, not a numerical or originality certificate.
claims.limitations: A targeted literature screen does not prove absence of prior results.
